command: set -e; CHOSEN=''; for f in "$HOME/.local-climate-link/android/release-signing.env" "$HOME/.local-climate-link/android-signing/release-signing.env"; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then unset LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD LCL_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS LCL_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD; set -a; . "$f"; set +a; if [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "$LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE" ] && [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-}" ] && [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS:-}" ] && [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then CHOSEN="$f"; break; fi; fi; done; test -n "$CHOSEN"; printf 'RELEASE_SIGNING_SOURCE=%s\n' "${CHOSEN#$HOME/}"; printf 'RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASENAME=%s\n' "$(basename "$LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE")"; LCL_RELEASE_VERSION=2.0.10 pnpm release:android
